name: Seven Nexus
storyline: Seven Nexus follows the story of Grey, a man who dies a sudden death and learns he’s an anomaly - a Nexus Being. No one knows how he lived or died, and as such, he can’t be judged by Purgatory. He doesn’t belong in either Heaven or Hell. To decide his fate, Grey must travel back to the human realm and complete Seven Trials, accompanied by two unlikely Guardians: an angel and a devil. Bound by the Supreme Being, they can guide, support, and tempt Grey but never interfere. Only Grey’s choices, virtuous or sinful, can shape the path ahead.
summary: Seven Nexus is an Adult BL/Gay Visual Novel about Grey, a man who dies but can’t go to Heaven or Hell. He must complete the Seven Trials on Earth, accompanied by two Guardians: an angel and a devil. Each choice draws Grey toward virtue or sin… and into deeper intimacy with his Guardians.
